**Flins** 
Adds Flins, a character from *Genshin Impact*, to *Stardew Valley*. 

Since the mod page from the previous version was removed, my detailed description is also gone. 

**Brief explanation (too much to type out in full, and I doubt you’ll conveniently come back to read it)**: 
Requires high-res portrait mod (Portraiture), loved items & schedule viewer (LookupAnything). 
This mod adds 33 events, including two (post-marriage) that modify the player’s item loss upon death. Some events are random – you can browse them via EventLookup. 

At the 8-heart event, you can obtain Flins’s Moon Wheel (requires TrinketTinker). 
At the 10-heart event, you can gain a special ability and trade artifacts. 
From 0 hearts to 6 stars, dialogue is fixed. At 8 hearts and 10 hearts, dialogue changes seasonally. 

The new flower can only be purchased from the Flower Dance shop. 
First, go to Pierre’s shop to trigger the cutscene. The next day, you’ll see Flins’s Lantern at the bus stop – enter it to reach the Lantern Space. 

I’ve also added five *Genshin Impact* music tracks to the game. They become available on the jukebox after you complete the corresponding story events.
